diagnostics.message: The integration can be created before the IAM role policies are attached, so Splunk may attempt AWS access before its permissions are ready. Add a dependency from :resource.signalfx_aws_integration.integration to :resource.aws_iam_role_policy.splunk_integration.

The integration can be created before the metric-stream managed policy is attached to the role, leaving required CloudWatch/IAM permissions unavailable during setup. Add a dependency from :resource.signalfx_aws_integration.integration to :resource.aws_iam_role_policy.splunk_managed_policy.
